transcript.text: had a crash at an intersection in Sunnybank, need to start a claim

Hi, I'm Sam, Wattle Car Insurance's AI claims assistant. I'm sorry to hear about the accident. I can help you start a claim now. If you'd like to talk to a person instead, just say so at any time.

First, is anyone hurt, or are you or anyone else in danger right now?
Nobody's hurt, thanks for checking. I'm okay to keep going.
Good to hear. First I need to confirm who you are. What's your policy number? If you don't have it handy, you can give me your date of birth and mobile number instead.

Thanks, Tom. You're verified, and I can see your 2022 Toyota RAV4 (rego 789XYZ) on the policy.

In your own words, can you tell me what happened at the intersection in Sunnybank?
actually my neck's starting to hurt, and my passenger hit her head on the window

Tom, please call 000 now. Neck pain after a crash and a hit to the head both need to be checked by a medical professional, even if they seem minor at first.

The claim can wait. I've stopped asking for details. I've also transferred you to a team member, who is joining this chat now. I've passed on what you've told me so far, so you won't need to repeat it.
